description: Search available vehicles with real prices for a company, office and dates. Prices are identical to the company's own web chat (mandatory charges, one-way and time rules included). Returns numbered offers and the session_id of this booking session.

driver_age.description: Main driver's age. The price and the available cars depend on it.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

return_office.description: Return office name or id when different (one-way).

session_id.description: Booking session id returned by a previous call for this company (offers, selection, customer details). Omitted, a new session starts.

name: search_availability
title: Search available cars and prices
